div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 镂空贴图 (树叶/松针/草地/发片/铁丝网) 在远景变秃消失或糊成死板实心块?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 渲染使用标准半透明混合 (Alpha Blend) 还是阈值裁剪 (Alpha Test / A2C)?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 使用标准 2x2 盒式均值 Mipmap (守恒平均透射率 ᾱ)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 如何生成或采样远景 Mipmap 层级 L 的 Alpha 通道?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: ❌ 振幅按 2^(-L) 坍缩向均值 ᾱ=0.35! Mip >= 2.0 处峰值 <= 0.50，树冠 100% 消失

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: ✅ 恢复对比度振幅或离线二分匹配覆盖率 · Mip 0..4 全程锁定 C = 37.50%
